entities.name: CemA (A7Y3F4)
observations: The 229-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Ipomoea purpurea CemA (UniProt A7Y3F4); its Pfam CemA domain spans residues 3–229.

Annotated as a chloroplast inner-membrane multi-pass protein contributing to light-dependent K+/H+ antiport, proton efflux, and chloroplast pH homeostasis; linked to modulation of photosynthesis and non-photochemical quenching.
